name: Drone / UAV Flight Software Engineer
description: Develop flight control software for drones and UAVs. Implement sensor fusion, flight modes, navigation, and communication protocols.
example_snippet:
program FlightController:
    shape Attitude holds:
        Roll as fractional number
        Pitch as fractional number
        Yaw as fractional number
    end shape

    action update_attitude takes A as ref Attitude, GyroX as fractional number, 
                              GyroY as fractional number, GyroZ as fractional number, 
                              Dt as fractional number produces nothing:
        put the sum of A.Roll and the product of GyroX and Dt into A.Roll
        put the sum of A.Pitch and the product of GyroY and Dt into A.Pitch
        put the sum of A.Yaw and the product of GyroZ and Dt into A.Yaw
    end action

    keep CurrentAttitude as Attitude with 0.0 and 0.0 and 0.0
    call update_attitude with CurrentAttitude and 0.1 and 0.0 and 0.05 and 0.01
    print the text "Roll: " and CurrentAttitude.Roll and newline
end program
